_comment: Everything this skill says that is not a number and not a lesson prompt.
`npm run voice:record` reads this file plus every lesson audioPrompt; a line
not yet recorded plays through live TTS, which is the normal state mid-build.
Number words are NOT declared here: the count-along says them through the
common pack, and a second copy would only override an identical one.
Nothing is listed that the engine does not actually say — a recorded line
nothing plays is the same waste as a switch nothing reads.
phrases: That is as big as it goes.
Every group needs the same number.
That is the one you were given.
They are back at the start.
